extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism scope; no direct antimicrobial mechanism assay is asserted.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: KPPepGen uses knowledge-aware pathogen prompts with diffusion generation to design pathogen-specific candidate antimicrobial peptides.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is a computational design/generation mechanism, not a direct biological antimicrobial mechanism assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Candidate prioritization used pathogen-specific classifiers, docking, MD simulation, MM-PBSA binding free-energy estimates, and RMSF stability analyses before wet-lab testing.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Docking and MD are screening evidence only and are not promoted to direct mechanism in bacterial cells.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Wet-lab MIC and CCK-8 assays support antimicrobial phenotype and low cytotoxicity for generated peptides, but the paper does not provide direct membrane disruption, uptake, target-binding, or resistance mechanism assays for Pep1-Pep10.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanism remains bounded to phenotype plus computational screening; no direct mechanism assay type is assigned.

caution_findings.note: MIC/CCK-8 establish activity and cytotoxicity, while docking/MD are computational screens only.
